No. How do you say two minutes؟
تينتين-- تنين دي إن، no. د-- uh، دإي إن.
turns.en: Two, two dee en, no. Dee en.

turns.text: Okay, we can review the homework then.
I don't think I did it right. [يضحك]
turns.en: I don't think I did it right.

turns.text: Um, do you want me to say it?
Do you remember what you wrote؟
يا مكنة غيري سؤالك الأول عشان مش وا-واحدة.
turns.en: Maybe change your first one, because it's not 'wahda'.

turns.text: What's wrong-- why does it say it's closed? تمام، غيري is right. Uh, لا، أنا. Yeah, okay.
turns.en: Why does it say it's closed? Okay, 'ghayyiri' is right; no, it's me. Yeah, okay.

turns.text: It wants you to say لأن which is stupid. You can say عشان أو لأن.
turns.en: It wants you to say 'li'anna', which is stupid; you can say 'ashan' or 'li'anna'.

turns.text: Oh, that's right, I'm supposed to add
a place for you to add notes.
My other room's lights are better than these.
So how would you do it؟
my other room's lights-- So، دواء
turns.en: My other room's lights-- so, medicine.
The room, no, the room's medicine.

turns.text: Oh، it just cleared. Oh، no. uh،
Or is it الـ تانية، right?
الـ-- That's right، yeah. الـ تانية أحسن منها دول.
turns.en: The-- that's right, yeah; the second one is better than these.

turns.text: It wants you to say أدوية. Don't use أدوية. دواء is...
turns.en: It wants you to say 'adwiya'; don't use 'adwiya', 'dawa' is...

turns.text: But you didn't put adwiya in there. Uh, I need to tell it to only use--
Yeah، it needs to use the words on our vocab sheet. Okay. I'll tell it.
My most favorite thing is to swim.
Oh، today's schedule is different from what we planned for last night.
Is it برنامج اليوم or no? Is it just برنامج-- Okay، so برنامج اليوم
turns.en: Is it 'today's program' or no? Is it just 'program'? Okay, so 'today's program'.

turns.text: You already-- Did you say شو or لا شو؟
turns.en: You already-- did you say 'shu' or 'la shu'?

turns.text: My most favorite thing is to swim.
Oh، I said this wrong. المفضل إشي عندي
turns.en: Oh, I said this wrong; my favorite thing.

turns.text: مفضل عندي. No L، N، N، No L بس للسباحة.
turns.en: Favorite for me; no 'l', only with swimming.

turns.text: How often, often do they visit you؟
ليش؟ Why did it assume that you're talking to a woman؟ You could be talking to a man.
turns.en: Why did it assume you're talking to a woman? You could be talking to a man.

turns.text: Yeah, I need to, I need to fix the, the correction.
Uh, كل أديش بزوروك يا بزوروك.
turns.en: Uh, as often as I visit you, I visit you.

turns.text: That's the one. I had to look that one up.
You ha-- [تنفس مفاجئ] what did you look up؟
turns.en: You, what did you look up?

turns.text: Okay, then I intended for you to remember كل قديش، بس بش وشكلة بيزوروا.
turns.en: Okay, I meant for you to remember 'kull 'adeish' (how much each), but it's no problem that you forgot 'bizoorou'.

turns.text: Yeah, I remember the كل أديش.
turns.en: Yeah, I remember 'kull 'adeish', meaning how much each.

turns.text: بس، uh, you've been doing it, you've do-- [تتلعثم] been doing a better job، so that's great.
turns.en: But you've been doing a better job, so that's great.

turns.text: More collocations, I think, until we get it right. [laughs] Okay.

turns.en: May God bless you, thank you.
You're welcome. Yalla, I'll see you.
